model: slapd (mdb backend), base dc=lab,dc=openmap,dc=test with inetOrgPerson/posixAccount users, a Service Accounts OU, groupOfNames and posixGroup groups

capture.command: slapd on docker network fxlab-e (10.250.70.30) with LDAP_ROOT=dc=lab,dc=openmap,dc=test and the lab tree loaded from LDAP_CUSTOM_LDIF_DIR, port 1389 published on 127.0.0.1:13890; a throwaway capture program inside apps/collectors ran the collector's own directory.Search(host, port, useTLS=false, startTLS=false, verify=false, "cn=admin,dc=lab,dc=openmap,dc=test", <random lab password>, baseDN="" (root DSE path), includeComputers=true) through a TCP proxy that wrote both directions byte for byte. Plain LDAP with simple bind so the conversation can be replayed.

files.name: ldap.client.ber
files.description: BER LDAPMessage stream the collector sent: bind, root DSE search, paged user/computer/group searches, unbind

files.name: ldap.server.ber
files.description: BER LDAPMessage stream slapd answered with: bind response, root DSE, search entries and done messages with paged-results controls

redactions.what: simple-bind password in the BindRequest (random per-run lab password)
redactions.replacement: same-length run of 'x' (0x78) bytes so BER lengths stay valid
